ruleDefinitions.name: Disable Tamper Protection on Windows Defender
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects disabling Windows Defender Tamper Protection Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Features\\\\TamperProtection.*") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Windows\ Defender\\MsMpEng\.exe")
